what: BUILD (M19 S3 instrument): a model-as-strategy adapter -- a strategy module under src/units/strategies/ that reads a REGISTERED model's per-closed-bar action {flat,long,short} + stop/target in ATR units and emits order packages through the SAME order_package()/monitor() contract every leg uses, so a model that proposes trades is graded by the existing harnesses (scripts/backtest_*.py via scripts/ops/build_strategy_evidence.py), net of the full cost stack, under the four-clause bar, exactly as a leg. Includes: a frozen-per-fold predictor (the model is fixed before each walk-forward fold as a leg's params are), triple-barrier labelling done by the HARNESS not the model, a --self-test with a planted always-flat model (must score net 0 R, the zero-trade baseline) and a planted oracle model (must score > 0). Nothing here reaches config/accounts.yaml or strategies.yaml -- wiring a live leg is new-strategy skill + Tier-3. Design and the registered S3 rule shape: docs/research/M19-ai-trader-postmortem-and-staged-path-2026-09-28.md § 4 'S3'. Without this instrument S3 cannot be queued (research/queue/README.md § blocked/: a question whose instrument does not exist is not a job), and grading S3 any other way repeats the post-mortem's Cause 1 (a proxy label graded by f1).
